name: Successful login with valid credentials redirects to the Nexo Desk Dashboard
objective: Verifies AC-8, AC-10, AC-11: Successful login with valid credentials redirects to the Nexo Desk Dashboard

testSteps.description: the user navigates to https://admin.nexolvi.ai
testSteps.expectedResult: the login page is displayed

testSteps.description: the user views the login form
testSteps.expectedResult: the Email field, Password field, Remember Me checkbox labelled 'Remember me for 30 days', and Sign In button are displayed

testSteps.description: the user enters '{{validEmail}}' in the Email field and 'admin' in the Password field and clicks Sign In
testSteps.expectedResult: the user is redirected to the Nexo Desk Dashboard

name: Sign In button becomes enabled when both Email and Password fields contain at least one character
objective: Verifies AC-4, BR-1: Sign In button becomes enabled when both Email and Password fields contain at least one character

testSteps.description: the user navigates to https://admin.nexolvi.ai
testSteps.expectedResult: the login page is displayed

testSteps.description: the user enters at least one character in the Email field and at least one character in the Password field
testSteps.expectedResult: the Sign In button is enabled

name: Password field masks its value by default on the login page
objective: Verifies AC-12, AC-16: Password field masks its value by default on the login page

testSteps.description: the user navigates to https://admin.nexolvi.ai
testSteps.expectedResult: the login page is displayed

testSteps.description: the user enters a value in the Password field
testSteps.expectedResult: the Password field value is masked

name: Clicking the eye icon once reveals the password and clicking it again re-masks it
objective: Verifies AC-13, AC-14: Clicking the eye icon once reveals the password and clicking it again re-masks it

testSteps.description: the user navigates to https://admin.nexolvi.ai
testSteps.expectedResult: the login page is displayed

testSteps.description: the user enters a value in the Password field and clicks the eye icon once
testSteps.expectedResult: the password text is visible in the Password field

testSteps.description: the user clicks the eye icon again
testSteps.expectedResult: the Password field value is masked

name: Selecting Remember Me during successful login persists the session for 30 days
objective: Verifies AC-9, BR-3: Selecting Remember Me during successful login persists the session for 30 days

testSteps.description: the user navigates to https://admin.nexolvi.ai
testSteps.expectedResult: the login page is displayed

testSteps.description: the user checks the Remember Me checkbox labelled 'Remember me for 30 days', enters '{{validEmail}}' in the Email field and 'admin' in the Password field, and clicks Sign In
testSteps.expectedResult: the user is redirected to the Nexo Desk Dashboard and the login session is persisted for 30 days

testSteps.description: the user enters '{{invalidEmail}}' in the Email field and 'admin' in the Password field and clicks Sign In
testSteps.expectedResult: the error message 'Login failed' is displayed in the page DOM and no browser alert is shown

name: Sign In button is disabled when only the Password field has a value
objective: Verifies AC-3, BR-1: Sign In button is disabled when only the Password field has a value

name: Sign In button becomes enabled when each field contains exactly one character

name: Sign In button returns to disabled state after clearing one field that was previously populated
objective: Verifies AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, BR-1: Sign In button returns to disabled state after clearing one field that was previously populated

testSteps.description: the user navigates to https://admin.nexolvi.ai
testSteps.expectedResult: the login page is displayed

testSteps.description: the user enters a value in the Email field and a value in the Password field
testSteps.expectedResult: the Sign In button is enabled

testSteps.description: the user clears the Password field
testSteps.expectedResult: the Sign In button is disabled

name: Password visibility toggles correctly across multiple consecutive eye icon clicks
objective: Verifies AC-14: Password visibility toggles correctly across multiple consecutive eye icon clicks

testSteps.description: the user navigates to https://admin.nexolvi.ai
testSteps.expectedResult: the login page is displayed

testSteps.description: the user enters a value in the Password field and clicks the eye icon once
testSteps.expectedResult: the password text is visible in the Password field

testSteps.description: the user clicks the eye icon a second time
testSteps.expectedResult: the Password field value is masked

testSteps.description: the user clicks the eye icon a third time
testSteps.expectedResult: the password text is visible in the Password field
